set.body: Add first-entry latency and maximal consecutive membership-run properties to the existing published AoiLaws.accounting API. Preserve zero-support sampled entries, arbitrary recording start times, background/exclusion separators and named support semantics. Do not merge the obsolete replacement AoiScene/AoiAccounting API. Verify production-source mutants on JVM and JS; land with the combined consolidation gate.
set.title: Recover sample-based AOI entry and run laws from the superseded branch
